Joseph died, as did all his brothers, and all that generation.
Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who didn’t know Joseph.
Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened, and heard, and a book of memory was written…
For what advantage has the wise more than the fool? What has the poor man, that knows how to walk before the living?

translations.web: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long forgotten. Indeed, the wise man must die just like the fool!
translations.bsb: For there is no lasting remembrance of the wise, just as with the fool, seeing that both will be forgotten in the days to come. Alas, the wise man will die just like the fool!
translations.kjv: For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now is in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dieth the wise man? as the fool.
translations.asv: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no remembrance for ever; seeing that in the days to come all will have been long forgotten. And how doth the wise man die even as the fool!
